evals.prompt: Prepare a timed brief for a 24-second silent Work desktop hero film using the real app. Show a project, a document, and a useful app. Planning only: do not claim any inspection or rendering has happened.
expectations: Actual UI and safe demo data verification remain pending.
Calm opening, connected motion, restrained captions.
Editable source, playable MP4, poster, and embedded-size checks.

evals.prompt: Revise a dark desktop film: its opening is rushed and a floating window covers the document. Preserve the accepted duration, silent soundtrack, palette, and outro.
expectations: Scoped pacing and collision corrections.
Review complete motion paths at normal speed and embedded size.
Leave validation pending until performed.

evals.prompt: The Work video shows unsent drafts and aimless chat resizing. Replace it with a purposeful demo: browse and scroll, create a floating chat through the palette, ask about Work, expand with the keyboard shortcut, then send a follow-up asking for a relevant app. Speed up creation, but type at human speed so the animations show.
expectations: A coherent goal connects the browser question, real answer, follow-up, and usable generated app.
Both messages visibly send; an echo test harness or injected transcript is not accepted as a real demo.
The expansion creates room for the follow-up; shrinking makes room to use the result.
Typing, palette mode changes, and chat transitions stay readable at normal speed. Only build waits are accelerated, with that timing edit identified.
The final app is actually interacted with, and evidence distinguishes compilation, visual checks, and failures.
Duration follows the meaningful story rather than forcing the whole sequence into the older 24-second default.

evals.prompt: Make a narrow revision to the Work website film. Keep the homepage title Work and the secondary titles Work · Page. We already removed the prepared-demo caption and the About this film section. The public site still has the older content, and Google search hits a CAPTCHA.
expectations: Preserve the accepted page titles and removed sections.
Do not reintroduce explanatory copy on the page to document capture setup.
Record the actual capture source and limitations in production notes. Do not splice direct navigation to imply a successful web search.
Leave unrelated product source, credentials, and other running worktrees undisturbed.

evals.prompt: Film a Work desktop take where the agent, running on my Claude Code setup, seeds a few chats and then builds the team an app. Start the take now.
expectations: Before any real agent turn, the person's own connectors, MCP servers and plugins are locked out of the demo project (lockdown.mjs or an equivalent check), and the check is reported.
Seed prompts stay local to the demo project and never ask the agent to email, schedule or post anything.
The take is rehearsed once with the same agent and build services before recording, and failures are retaken rather than spliced.

evals.prompt: The homepage film looks soft and has no visible pointer. Fix it without changing the story.
expectations: Capture comes at the window's physical size for the display (Retina 2560x1600 from a 1280x800 window, or 1680x1050 with zoom 1.3125 on a 1x display); frames are not upscaled.
The pointer is drawn in the render from the logged input, hidden while typing.
The story, asks and accepted cuts are kept; only the affected frames and adjacent cuts are rechecked.
